_README: Fill in each PC's DDB characterId — the number in the sheet URL: dndbeyond.com/characters/<characterId>. This is NOT the userId (userId is the account/player; it's here only as a cross-reference, confirmed from the Supabase roll data). Get characterIds once from the campaign page (each character links to /characters/<id>). Sheets must be set to Public or Campaign-Only on DDB for the no-login fetch to work; Private sheets return 403 and are skipped. The fetch only reads characterId + name; userId/note are ignored by the script.
